en.name: Lost Mooncourt
en.description: There was a time when the moon did not rise in solitude as it does today. In those days, three moons caressed the earth with their silver light, and the lunar people knew the secrets of the lunar phases, being able to predict the tidal ebb and flow. Whatever they gently touched with their fingers would surge with moonlit might. Yet in the waning days, the moonlight dimmed, and the people, defenseless and leaderless, were scattered. Legend has it that the Frostmoon Scions constructed a lunar court in the border realms, summoning lost moonlight back to them. Today, that reflected light has disappeared from this forsaken altar. Where it once flowed through these stone carvings, there is now only frozen silence. Yet secrets unveiled in that quietude, perhaps the echoes of ancient oaths, still swirl about within the labyrinth of time.

en.name: Moonchild's Treasures
en.description: In an age long forgotten by those who now dwell beneath the moon, the descendants of the far north once raised a tower upon this land. To the followers of the morning star, it served as a sign of their resolve to resist the decree of fate and the will of the gods, and it bore witness to a dream that once shone with radiant brilliance before the sky-fire reduced it to ash. Within this place, the priests of the Moonchildren concealed the last sparks of an ancient civilization's splendor and its long-lost miracles. Their hope was that, when the light of the Welkin Moon at last returned to the earth, it would lead the wandering and displaced back to their former paradise. Yet when the tower fell and its sacred Mekhaneikos were carried off by those with ill intent, the last generations of that distant era let even their hope fade from memory, and they drifted into the shadow of ignorance and confusion. Now, only the owls that remain among these ruins give voice to the dream that time has buried, lamenting what once was and what has long since been forgotten.
